text: The La Pointe log, November '86: "Schooner Lucerne's masts showing above water a mile and a half off, all hands lost. A boat seen working over her by night, no light shown."
An underwriter's letter, never answered: the company's strongbox aboard the Lucerne, gold coin for the Ashland ore docks' payroll, was "not recovered by the salvors, nor any trace of it."
A page torn from the Hermit Island Brownstone Co.'s cash book, October '93: "Last payroll, in gold, carried out by the clerk E. Wilkes. No receipt returned."

source.name: the carving in the lookout's rock

text: Cut into the rock at Hermit's lookout: a pick, the letters E.W., and an arrow pointing to the cabin in the woods to the east.
A note in a warehouse desk, unsigned: "Point light. New moon. Two short, one long. Leave it where we left the last, at the foot."
Fresh lamp soot inside the old tower's door, though no lamp's been lit there in fifteen years, and boot prints going round its foot in the sand.
from: the old light on Minnesota Point

text: The Devils Island log, August '97: "A skiff seen going into the third cave west of the light after dark. None came out by morning. Moon new."

source.name: the marks cut in the back wall

text: Cut into the back of the first cave on Devils Island: III, an arrow pointing south along the shore, and a crescent moon struck through.
from: a carving in a Devils Island cave

text: The Outer Island log: "Pedersen of the sandspit camp went out the 3rd; his boat came ashore empty. His nets, hauled since, bring up brass and glass from no wreck we know of."

source.name: the old net on the reel

text: Tangled in Pedersen's old net on the reel: a green glass float, a brass hinge, and a sliver of lighthouse glass. Whatever he was raising, he kept it close to the fish house.
